Your science-adjacent storytelling and VELUX copy and video work fit, and startup experience is listed as an asset. It is a one-year term to December 2027. Apply by 24 Nov; about 130 people have clicked apply.

Consulting is not one of your sectors and it is a 12-month cover. Over 130 people have clicked apply, so send it soon.

Uses your event organising more than your video work. English is required and Danish is only an advantage. About 100 applicants.

jobs.notes: Comms for a UNSW research centre: helping researchers tell their work clearly, comms plans and media training. Your research background and storytelling both count, and it is 35 hours a week. Three-year fixed term. Check work rights for Australia.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
jobs.notes: NGO content role across social, video, copy and storytelling, very close to your skill set. Listed as entry level, so pay may be under your target (inferred). Check work rights for Australia. 77 applicants.

jobs.title: Communications and Engagement Consultant
jobs.notes: Community engagement and project comms for an engineering and architecture firm, in the built environment you enjoyed at VELUX, with community events and open days. Mid-senior level. Check work rights for New Zealand. Apply by 27 Nov.
